Natural Body Magic (NBM) is something almost everybody in this world can do. People with NBM can painlessly detach their body parts. Detached body parts are affected by gravity in the usual way (they don't float in the air!). Body parts can also be involuntarily detached with sufficient force, such as a punch, sharp pull, tackle, or collision. Bigger impacts can cause someone to completely fall apart. Instead of a wound, both sides of the detached part are covered with skin. Detaching body parts like this cannot kill anyone.
